message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts: From Dec 2014 to Jan 7 2015, defendant Xiang (项某) repeatedly convened several people in a rented house to conduct gambling activities using "炸鸡" (likely a code for a gambling method) and illegally obtained more than 10,000 RMB. So the crime is illegal gambling (组织赌博) and possibly profit from gambling. Under Chinese criminal law, the relevant offense is "组织赌博罪" (organizing gambling) or "开设赌场罪". Also "非法经营罪"? But the fact is about organizing gambling and illegal profit. The law: Article 303 of Criminal Law: "组织赌博、开设赌场的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "组织赌博罪". Also participants may be charged with "赌博罪" but the defendant is organizer. So we list "组织赌博罪". Also "非法占有他人财物" not relevant. So answer: [罪名]组织赌博罪<eoa>.

Check if multiple crimes: Could also be "非法牟利罪"? Not a specific crime. So just one.

Thus final answer.
